title: Understanding the Value of Your Mineral Rights: Essential Factors to Consider
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 33b8565a8265e3e42939d1f41bc08ad3210e721501c1372fd5a4dd5640291043; all 7 declared sources passed live access review.

Claims remain bounded to current RRC production, query-lag, correction, and data-set context; EIA commodity-series context; and current MRX methodology and selling-options scope. The article preserves source purpose and does not turn any source into an owner-specific title, reserves, development, price, value, offer, or decision result.

The article uses no fabricated owners, properties, buyers, contracts, prices, acreage, ownership decimals, production, reserves, forecasts, tax results, offers, testimonials, success rates, or owner-specific title, legal, tax, accounting, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusions.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas production data (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas describes the production page as compilations and summaries of production information reported by Texas operators and links production queries, downloads, and visualizations.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for dated reported Texas production context; it does not establish private title, an owner decimal, realized royalty price, reserves, future production, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas Production Data Query FAQs (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The RRC PDQ FAQs explain Texas reporting organization, reporting lag, operator-submitted data, revisions, corrections, delinquent reports, and the snapshot nature of query results.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to explain why production evidence needs property, period, retrieval-date, and version controls; it does not resolve owner-specific title, payment, reserves, development, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas data sets available for download (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas lists current production and operating data sets, their formats, update cadence, coverage, and data-set descriptions.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for dated Texas production and operating-data availability; it does not establish private title, an owner decimal, realized royalty price, reserves, future development, or value.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. EIA crude-oil spot prices (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes dated monthly crude-oil spot-price series.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the series only as an example of reproducible dated commodity context; it does not treat a benchmark as a property-specific realized price, forecast, or value conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. EIA natural-gas data (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes natural-gas price data, including dated spot and futures price series.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only as an example of dated market evidence; it does not establish a property-specific realized price, differential, forecast, or value.

sources_inspected.label: MRX methodology (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX methodology describes a directional discounted-cash-flow review with dated evidence, stated production, decline, operator, royalty, commodity, discount, title, acreage, and offer-term inputs and ranges under assumptions.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for the directional-range output lane and professional limits; it does not establish owner-specific title, reserves, value, tax treatment, suitability, or a transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: MRX Sell Mineral Rights (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX Sell Mineral Rights page separates selling all, selling a defined portion, and holding and identifies scope, complete proposals, adjustment rights, diligence, professional review, funding, timing, and recording as decision topics.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for seller-option and complete-proposal comparison categories; it does not recommend a path or establish a particular agreement’s meaning, fairness, legal effect, or suitability.
